newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares higher on strong buying interest.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares higher on strong buying interest.

text.p: Shares on the United Arab Emirates (UAE) unofficial stock market ended the week to Thursday higher in brisk trade, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index rose 10.42 points to 2,529.06 points from 2,518.82 points a week earlier.
Brokers said buying interest was vivid after a five-day Moslem holiday which ended on Monday.

Among major gainers in the week were al-Khazna Insurance Co which closed 15 dirhams higher at 300 dirhams, Mashreq Bank which ended 10 dirhams higher at 835 dirhams and market leader Etisalat which closed at 960 dirhams from 955 last week.
